! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! ***** DEFINITION OF MODEL CONTROL INFORMATION ******************************************************************************
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! NOTE: lines starting with "!" are treated as comment lines -- there is no limit on the number of comment lines.
!
!    lines starting with <xxx> are read till "!" 
!    Do not leave lines without "!" at the beginning of the lines
!    This is a basic configurations. For more adanced configurations, see https://mizuroute.readthedocs.io/en/cesm-coupling/index.html
!   
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! DEFINE DIRECTORIES 
! --------------------------
<ancil_dir>         /data/ancillary_data/                         ! directory containing ancillary data (river network, remapping netCDF) 
<input_dir>         /data/input/                                  ! directory containing input data (runoff netCDF) 
<output_dir>        /output/                                 ! directory containing output data
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! DEFINE TIME PERIOD OF THE SIMULATION
! --------------------------------------------
<case_name>         case1                                     ! simulation case name
<sim_start>         1950-01-01 12:00:00                       ! time of simulation start (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss)
<sim_end>           1950-01-03 12:00:00                       ! time of simulation end (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss)
<restart_write>     last                                      ! restart write option. never, last, yearly, monthly, daily, specified (need to specify date with <restart_date> 
!<fname_state_in>   v1.2_case2.mizuRoute.r.yyy-mm-hh.sssss.nc ! input netCDF for channel states 
<newFileFrequency>  single                                    ! output netcdf frequency. daily, monthly, yearly, single
<outputFrequency>   daily                                     ! output frequency (integer for multiple of simulation time step or daily, monthly or yearly) 
<dt_qsim>           86400                                     ! simulation time interval [sec]
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! ROUTE options
! --------------------------
<route_opt>         5                                      ! option for routing schemes 0-> runoff accum, 1->IRF, 2->KWT, 3->KW, 4->MC, 5->DW 
<doesBasinRoute>    1                                         ! basin routing?  0-> no, 1-> basin UH
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! DEFINE RIVER NETWORK FILE 
! ---------------------------------------
<fname_ntopOld>     ntopo_nhdplus_cameo_pfaf.nc               ! name of netCDF containing river segment data 
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! DEFINE RUNOFF FILE
! ----------------------------------
<fname_qsim>        runoff_case1.in                           ! name of netCDF containing the HRU runoff
<units_qsim>        mm/s                                      ! units of runoff
<dt_ro>             86400                                     ! time interval of the runoff
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! DEFINE RUNOFF MAPPING FILE 
! ----------------------------------
<is_remap>          F                                         ! logical to indicate runnoff needs to be mapped to river network HRU 
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! Namelist file name 
! ---------------------------
<param_nml>         param.nml.default                         ! spatially constant model parameters 
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
! ****************************************************************************************************************************
<pio_netcdf_type> netcdf ! explicit backend provided by this image
